title: Evaluation on a subset indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $c$ assign a real coefficient to each subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $U$ be such a subset. Evaluating the associated numerical polynomial at the binary vector that is $1$ exactly on $U$ gives $\\sum_{S\\subseteq U}c(S)$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ assigns real coefficients to subsets of the $n$ coordinates
$U$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
